messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: I live in Boston and my bicycle is blue.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Where do you keep your bicycle?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: I keep it in my garage.

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: I moved to Seattle yesterday. I still have my blue bicycle.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Did you bring the bicycle with you?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Yes, it is now in my garage in Seattle.
